messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "patients with eGFR below 30 mL/minute/1.73 m2"
set: ["patients with eGFR below 30 mL/minute/1.73 m2", "patients with eGFR between 30 to 45 mL/minute/1.73 m2", "discontinue this medication if eGFR falls below 30 mL/minute/1.73 m2", "assess risk/benefit of continuing if eGFR falls below 45 mL/minute/1.73 m2", "pediatric patients with glomerular filtration rate less than 30 mL/min", "patients with epilepsy", "patients with lupus", "patients with kidney problems", "patients with breathing problems", "patients with breathing disorder", "patients with hepatic impairment", "geriatric patients with depression", "patients with type 1 diabetes", "no strength below 150 mg", "patients with history of seizures", "30 mg/mL"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
